ARGUMENT_WITH_NO_ORIGIN.note: the registry emits keys of these names, so the model has seen values that look like them, but no tool can ORIGINATE one -- every emitter also demands one. Whether that is a defect depends on the argument: a search `pattern` is the model's to compose, an identifier that must match something on disk is not. The enumerator vocabulary is listed so the reader can tell which is which.
